source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.3.2, printed pages 232-233 (PDF 235-236). The receptor diagram and opiate/opioid note are our aids.

blocks.text: Opiates dawaiyon ki aik qisam hai jo afeem ke paude (opium poppy) se aati hain. Yeh dard ko bohat taqat se door karti hain (pain relievers), lekin nasha (addiction) bhi paida karti hain. Qanooni (legal) dawaiyon mein morphine, codeine, oxycodone, hydrocodone waghera shamil hain. Ghair qanooni (illegal) qisam mein heroin, fentanyl waghera jaisi drugs aati hain.

blocks.title: Opiates aur opioids
blocks.text: Asal mein opiates afeem ke qudrati compounds hain (morphine, codeine). Oxycodone, hydrocodone aur heroin in se banaye jaate hain, aur fentanyl poori tarah lab mein bana (synthetic) hai; in sab ko opioids kehte hain. Fentanyl doctor ke nuskhe wali qanooni dawa bhi hai (maslan operation mein behoshi ke waqt), agarche ghair qanooni taur par bhi bechi jaati hai.
Opioid receptors ka concept (Concept of Opioid Receptors)

blocks.title: Endorphins
blocks.text: Insaan ka dimagh apni dard-kush dawaiyan khud banata hai jinhein endorphins kehte hain. Yeh hamare Central Nervous System (CNS, dimagh aur haram maghz ka nizam) mein opioid receptors se jurti hain. Opiates is qudrati system par “qabza” (hijack) kar lete hain: yeh dard door karte hain magar bohat nasha-awar (addictive) bhi hain.

Opioid receptors teen qisam ke hain. Mu (μ) receptors dimagh aur spinal cord (haram maghz) mein hote hain. Morphine jaise zyada tar opioids ka asal nishana yahi hain. Opiates ka dard door karne wala asar (analgesic activity) inhi se hota hai, lekin in ke active hone se respiratory depression (saans ka sust ho jana) aur shadeed euphoria (be-had khushi ka nasha) bhi ho sakta hai. Kappa (κ) receptors spinal cord ki satah par dard door karne (spinal analgesia) aur ghunoodgi (sedation) mein hissa lete hain, lekin euphoria se in ka talluq kam hai. Delta (δ) receptors jazbaat (emotional response) aur mood ko qaboo mein rakhne mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain.
Kaam karne ka tareeqa (Mechanism of Action)

blocks.title: Opioid receptors
blocks.text: Opiates dimagh aur spinal cord ke kuch khaas proteins se jur kar kaam karte hain; in proteins ko opioid receptors kehte hain.

Yeh chaabi (opiate) aur taala (receptor) ki tarah kaam karta hai. Jab opiate receptor se jurta hai to dard ke signals ko dimagh tak pohanchne se rok deta hai, is liye insaan ko dard kam mehsoos hota hai. Asal mein jab opiate receptor se jurta hai to calcium channels band ho jaate hain aur potassium channel khul jaata hai. Is se neuron (nerve cell) hyperpolarize ho jata hai (us ki andar ki charge aur zyada manfi ho jaati hai), aur cell ke liye dard ka signal aage bhejna bohat mushkil ho jata hai. Tajurbe se pata chala hai ke opiates dimagh ke reward center (khushi mehsoos karane wale hisse) mein aik neurochemical reaction shuru karte hain, jis se dopamine bohat zyada kharij hoti hai, aur sukoon aur khushi ka ehsaas hota hai.

blocks.alt: Nerve-cell membrane ki patti: baen taraf receptor (lock) mein opiate (key) jura hai; beech mein Ca2+ channel band ('closed'); daen taraf K+ channel khula jis se K+ bahar nikalta hai ('K+ flows out').
blocks.caption: Opiate ka receptor se jurna: Ca2+ channel band, K+ channel khula (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Opioids acute pain (achanak aur thori der ka dard) door karne ke liye use hote hain. Cancer ke shadeed dard ko qaboo karne mein bhi in ka istemal hota hai. Codeine jaise opioids khansi ke sharbat (cough syrup) mein dale jaate hain kyunke yeh khansi ka reflex dabate hain. Yeh gastrointestinal tract (maida aur aantein) ke receptors se jur kar hazme ko sust karte hain aur dast (diarrhea) mein aaram de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did You Know?)
blocks.text: Sarak ka nasha banne se pehle Heroin (diacetylmorphine) Bayer company ki trademark dawa thi, jo morphine ke “nasha na karne wale” (non-addictive) mutabadil aur bachon ki khansi ki dawa ke taur par bechi jaati thi. Is ki taqat morphine se taqreeban paanch guna hai, aur yeh blood-brain barrier (khoon aur dimagh ke beech ki rukawat) jaldi paar karti thi, jis se aik “rush” (achanak nasha) paida hota tha. Isi se poori duniya mein nashe ki waba phail gayi.

blocks.prompt: Morphine ka asal nishana kaun sa opioid receptor hai, aur is ke active hone se kaun se side effects ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Mu (μ) receptor. Dard door karne ke saath yeh saans ki susti (respiratory depression) aur shadeed euphoria bhi paida kar sakta hai.

items: Opiates afeem se aate hain; dard door karte hain magar nasha-awar hain.
Endorphins jism ke apne dard-kush hain; opiates unhi receptors par qabza karte hain.
Teen receptors: Mu (dard, saans ki susti, euphoria), Kappa (spinal analgesia, sedation), Delta (mood).
Ca²⁺ channels band, K⁺ channel khula: neuron hyperpolarize, dard ka signal ruk jata hai.
Istemal: acute aur cancer ka dard, khansi (codeine), dast.
